scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:ts && npm run build:assets && npm run lint:webext
scripts.build:ts: npm run check:ts && esbuild --bundle --target=chrome89,firefox89 --format=esm --outdir=dist src/*.ts && esbuild --bundle --target=chrome89,firefox89 --format=esm --outdir=dist ../src/audio-processor-worker.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --channel unlisted && mv web-ext-artifacts/*.xpi audio-pitch-changer-`jq -r .version < ./assets/manifest.json`.xpi
